entity.name: Hitoshi Yamamoto
entity.description: Author and sole maintainer of soapbar, a security-hardened SOAP 1.1/1.2 library for Python (client, server, and WSDL handling) with typed clients for public services such as EU VIES, SEFAZ NF-e, CCEE, and ANA.

projects.name: soapbar
projects.description: A SOAP library for Python — client, server, and WSDL handling. Implements SOAP 1.1 and 1.2 with all five binding styles, auto-generates WSDL from Python service classes, integrates with any ASGI or WSGI framework, and is hardened against XXE and DoS by default. Ships WS-Security (UsernameToken, XML Signature, XML Encryption, WS-I BSP X.509), MTOM/XOP, WS-Addressing, and typed contrib clients for real-world government/industry services (EU VIES, SEFAZ NF-e, WITSML, ANA). Verified interoperable with zeep and spyne; public API frozen by a CI-enforced snapshot; 116-test internal conformance suite.
